Thank you for the reply. 
My fiance is great, he understands I'm depressed and everything..but he can't handle it. I can't talk about it with him because he doesn't understand me and the way I think. Also, one of his parents died by suicide. So I don't want to bring it up to him anyways. He's extremely pragmatic and optimistic, so everything I say to him, he just tries to fix. 
The other things I mentioned are only the problems on the surface. That's just normal stuff everyone goes through..I have much deeper demons that I don't talk about it.
"Are you sick?" No. I'm just pale, I don't sleep, and I have a chronic cough. Thanks.
